Senior QA Engineer for the Defence Sector
 Do you want your testing to shape a product from its earliest stage? As Senior QA Engineer in the IRIS team, you will help NATO nations work together on successful missions. You will ask critical questions and keep quality high from the first idea to release.
 The job
 You will be responsible for the quality of our IRIS products throughout the whole feature lifecycle. You will work closely with developers, architects, product owners and project managers. Early test involvement is the heart of the role, in order for us to ensure building in great quality from the beginning.
In short, you can look forward to:
Owning the quality assurance for your specific area of the programme.
Participating in system tests, bug hunts and service packs and all other QA related activities.
Developing and maintaining QA documentation, including test conditions, test cases, risk assessments, and defect reports.
Analyse and clarify requirements and participate in estimation.
Create test ware to support qualifying the features.
Execute quality assurance on all levels.
Giving clear feedback on testing progress, results and product quality.
 Joining the team
 You will join the IRIS team in our Defence business unit. We are about 26 colleagues, spread across Romania and Denmark, and we work closely together. Trusted by NATO nations, IRIS provides flexible, adaptable, off-the-shelf software solutions that support effective military communication and interoperability. Join us and help shape the future of defence technology while developing your skills and growing your career. In Systematic we have well-defined career tracks with great opportunity of making a difference.
 What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in computer science or similar technical degree, or several years of experience working in QA.
Fluent English skills, both verbally as well as written English – preferably level C.
3+ years of experience as a QA engineer.
Experience working with a test tool like TestRail, Xray or similar would be preferred.
Working experience in the Defence sector will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Experience with the Linux CLI, Docker & Kubernetes would be nice to have.
Experience with Jira, Xray and R4J would be nice to have.
You work independently and take ownership of your tasks.
You are proactive, self-driven, detail-oriented, structured and analytical.
 You will be working at our Bucharest office at least three days a week closely together with your team. Occasional travel to Denmark for one to two weeks per year is part of the role.
Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.
 Welcome to Systematic Bucharest 
 Systematic Romania, the second-largest office with over 190 employees, is conveniently located near Piata Romana. You can start your day with a delicious breakfast in the canteen and choose the option to order fresh meals for lunch. Find daily fruits and beverages and step out onto the terrace for a breath of fresh air. The recreation room offers board games, foosball, and table tennis for some friendly competition, and we even provide office massage sessions to help you relax. Thanks to our Employees' Club, you can join exciting social events like karting, treasure hunts, and themed parties. Plus, getting here is easy with an indoor parking lot and public transport just around the corner. 
 Never stop developing 
 Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1200 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong. 
 Start your development here 
 We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now.
